name: mycrew-pipeline
description: Layer 2/5 of the mycrew harness — the build pipeline. Six stage skills that carry one task from a decision to hardened code: /how-to-do (decide a fork), /do (build it by a tight set of writing rules), then /refactor (clean it and reuse what exists), /review (edge cases and bugs), /secure (the holes) and /test to harden and ship it. In /review and /secure the eyes that hunt and the eyes that rule are never the author's — only the fixes are. Skills only. Built on mycrew-tools; driven by mycrew-worker.
